statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: TAGGED relationships written before AWSTag moved to the data model have no _sub_resource_id, so the MatchLink cleanup never matches them. Remove this account's stale ones. Will be removed in v1.0.0.
statements.query: MATCH (:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->()-[r:TAGGED]->(:AWSTag) WHERE r._sub_resource_id IS NULL AND r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN COUNT(*) AS TotalCompleted
